body:
Finite complex-supplier construction with an exact scoped cost floor; **no new kappa**.

The selected PR799 X4 compensation panel uses 6,320 separately prepared additions. A restored signed target forest reduces it to **2,324 additions**, including all **106 preparation and 106 restoration gates**. Under the unchanged binary-Horner lowering:

| Complete scalar projection | Original real primitives | Candidate | Saved |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Forward | 193,162 | 145,472 | 47,690 |
| Inverse transpose | 193,210 | 145,520 | 47,690 |

This is **13,890 additional primitives saved per orientation** beyond #901's reported disjoint-pair result on the same panel. The complete candidate is repriced; predecessor savings are not added. All source access, coefficient work, boundary operations and restoration are charged. Paid children and non-scalar events compare unchanged.

The 113-vertex minimum spanning tree attains **10,883 compensation primitives per real component** (21,766 real primitives). The complete **12,544-edge** census, independently implemented Prim solver and every cycle inequality certify the optimum only within the signed-unit single-parent forest class with independently lowered coefficients. Shared work, other lowerings, helper changes and boundary folding are outside that floor.

Reproduce offline, standard-library Python 3.9+:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-x4-target-forest/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_X4_TARGET_FOREST compensation=6320->2324 saved_real=47690/47690 forest_floor=10883 columns=737 orientations=2 no_new_kappa`.

Validation includes full literal scalar-primitive replay on **737 arbitrary input columns** in both orientations, independent compensation operators on 328 active columns, eight microcircuits, five primary and seven independent controls, nine package tests, relocated source loading/census, and the selected-record check plus its five tests. Isolated optimized CPython **3.14.6 and 3.9.6** reproduce the exact receipt. The missing-preparation mutant passes a helper-only replay but fails arbitrary-target checking. Forward positive-prefix budget stays 55 bits; reverse rises from 72 to **74 bits**, within the inherited 192-bit allowance. Exact fractional depths remain 3/19.

Exact base and refreshed main: **`91a2094f2e022930069e8cfdc810a3ea1b81cd09`**. OS assignment seed **34**, complex-supplier track. Inputs are pinned accepted replay members, bound to PR799's canonical and emitted-program hashes. Only `research/complex-x4-target-forest/` is added; the selected certificate and `upstream/` are unchanged. No pinned sprint issue existed. The final overlap inventory contained 721 open PRs through #931; #901 and #816 retained their inspected heads.

Credit **@dd-hemant #816** (`133735a2cc2319c12ba5d786214b2217e083e7da`) for this signed rational forest/MST mechanism on historical CK, **Oscar Fennell #759** for binary forests/superroot reduction, **Sricharan Vagvala #749** for rational pairs, and **ToikY #901** (`dbe8dc01f8306bd7dab8d861a953b23e5cda6a70`) for selected-X4 disjoint pairs. This transports the existing forest mechanism to selected X4 and checks its additional saving and family floor; it does not claim invention of that mechanism. No pending implementation is imported. #909's nonunit disjoint-pair exclusion leaves overlapping bases outside scope; #917 concerns historical CK/helper bases, and #883/#916 concern preceding X4 preconditions. Credit **Jeremy Kothe #799**, **Chafik Boukhalfa #741**, **icekylinx** and the retained supplier lineage.

Scalar interpreters do not execute physical Clifford/frame/phase events. Typed production admission, refreshed bindings, global owner/hosting/invoice/assembly and inherited all-size/compiler, realization, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain. Full repository/cold supplier suites, hosted CI and Lean were not run. The selected conditional kappa remains **0.001661634653669567**; no full multiplication theorem or runtime speedup is claimed.

Prepared by **Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate AI implementations and mathematical review. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed. Proof, exact recipe, source pins, receipt, local claim and validation/handoff are included.
title: Finite construction: selected X4 target forests save 47,690 primitives with an exact class floor (no new kappa)
